prompt: Write an email to the manager of the moving company in about 150–200 words. Your email should: Explain why you chose the moving company and what services were promised. Describe the problems you experienced and how they affected you. Explain what you would like the company to do to resolve the situation.
essay:
Dear Manager,

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service provided by your company. To begin with, I was very impressed by the reviews , and those reviews convinced me to choose your moving service. Your staff assured me that the work would be completed within the agreed timeframe and that the household appliances would be packed securely.

Although your staff arrived on time, they were unable to load my belongings into the truck on time. Consequently, I vacated my current house later than the agreed-upon time. I had to pay an additional $500 to my landlord because of the delay. The staff did not pack the appliances securely; as a result, my fridge and washing machine were damaged.

I would really appreciate it if you could reimburse me for the cost of $350 that I spent to repair the damaged appliances and the additional $500 that I paid to the landlord. I hope that your company will take the necessary measures so that your future customers will not experience similar issues.

Thank you so much for considering my request, and I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Sincerely,

Chaitanya Kacharla
